subject.title: fix(android): stop push-to-talk from dropping speech after mid-hold pauses

question: Should the Android owner accept the new segmented/raw-audio capture ladder after the unpunctuated-segment repair and real-device proof, or prefer a narrower restart-only fix for the established PTT regression?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and device-specific SpeechRecognizer behavior require an owner to judge the appropriate support boundary after the concrete transcript defect is repaired.

options.title: Repair and prove the ladder
options.body: Join unpunctuated segments without synthetic punctuation, then provide redacted on-device evidence for the affected hold and release flows before reviewing the full ladder.

options.title: Narrow the fix
options.body: Retain a restart-during-hold repair only if the owner does not want to support the broader API-33 raw-audio and segmented-session behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove the ladder
recommendation.body: Join unpunctuated segments without synthetic punctuation, then provide redacted on-device evidence for the affected hold and release flows before reviewing the full ladder.
